_editing: Volunteer programme. `opportunities` drives the Get Involved list; set `open: false` to keep one listed but closed. The student programme copy sits in content/pages/student-service-hours.en.md.

intro.en: The mandir has no paid staff. Every aarti sung, every meal cooked, every blanket packed is volunteer seva. There is a place for every skill and for every amount of time you can give — including none at all, which is also fine.
intro.mr: मंदिरात कोणीही पगारी कर्मचारी नाही. प्रत्येक सेवा स्वयंसेवकांमार्फत होते.

description.en: Serve and clear mahaprasad at the monthly upasana. No cooking experience needed — the kitchen team handles preparation.
Cooking for upasana and utsav. Useful if you are comfortable cooking at scale, but the team will teach you.

commitment.en: One weekend day, a few times a year

description.en: Sorting, packing and loading for the food, blanket, school supply and toy drives. Physically active seva.

commitment.en: Half a day, a few times a year

description.en: Deliver packed goods to partner shelters and food banks. Requires a valid licence and a vehicle that can carry boxes.
Parking direction, queue management and helping elderly devotees. The single largest need at Pragat Din.

commitment.en: A few hours a month, remote

description.en: Writing, photography, video editing, translation into Marathi, and keeping this website current. Can be done entirely from home.
Preparing the sanctum, arranging flowers, helping newcomers find their place in the booklet.

summary.en: High school students earn verified community service hours through seva at the mandir — accepted for graduation requirements and college applications.
summary.mr: हायस्कूल विद्यार्थ्यांना मंदिरातील सेवेतून प्रमाणित सेवा तास मिळतात.

activities.en: Supply chain support for seva drives

requirements.en: Guardian consent on file before the first shift, for students under 18
Sign in and sign out at the volunteer desk for every shift
A minimum of one completed shift before a letter can be issued

guardianConsentNote.en: For students under 18 we require a guardian's written consent before the first shift. This covers participation, emergency contact and permission for photographs at public events. Consent can be withdrawn at any time by emailing info@shrigajananseva.org.
guardianConsentNote.mr: १८ वर्षांखालील विद्यार्थ्यांसाठी पालकांची लेखी संमती आवश्यक आहे.

letterProcess.en: Hours are logged by the volunteer lead at the end of each shift.
A seva team lead verifies the log within one week.
Request a letter from your account, or by emailing info@shrigajananseva.org.
The letter is issued on Shri Gajanan Seva letterhead with a verification code your school can check with us.
